snippet.title: FOAMGRAVE  | The World Sank. Stay Afloat. | Cinematic Playtest Trailer #gaming #gameplay
snippet.description:
THE OCEAN TOOK EVERYTHING.
NOW IT'S ALL THAT'S LEFT.
Your boat is your home, workshop and weapon. Customize your cabin and deck, gather resources, craft supplies and battle pirates in an ocean survival sandbox. Sail solo or with friends.

Playtest / Demo Live now on STEAM !
